name: I See Me
detailed_description:
Become Mimi, who has crossed the Rainbow Bridge, and little Hojin, who has come to save her. Embark on a journey together and return safely!
But beware — a trial awaits: your sights will be swapped.

What is I See Me?

I See Me means "seeing myself through the eyes of another."
You will control your character by looking at how they appear on your partner’s screen.
Conversely, your partner sees you through your own screen.

Unique Gameplay

In I See Me, you play as Mimi and Hojin, whose sights have been switched.
You must rely on your partner’s screen and voice to guide your actions.
Cooperate closely and trust each other to overcome the trials and reach your destination together.
To succeed, you’ll need to make sure your partner can see their character through your camera.
True cooperation is the only way forward.

The Power to Escape Trials

By using items, you can temporarily break free from the trial.
Take advantage of the brief moment when your view is restored to tackle difficult sections.

Memories of Mimi and Hojin

Discover memory fragments to uncover the hidden story of Mimi and Hojin.
Collect these fragments to unlock story content through Achievements.

Challenging Difficulty

Swapped sights aren't the only obstacles.
Countless hardships stand in the way of Mimi and Hojin’s journey.
Overcome various challenges that block your path to the destination.
It won't be easy... Prepare for a true test of teamwork and perseverance.
